registry.custodian: Municipalidad Provincial de Cajamarca, Subgerencia de Planificación Territorial y Centro Histórico / Subgerencia de Ordenamiento Territorial y Catastro
registry.evidence: Official municipal pages state that the subgerencia prepares and maintains the urban and rural cadastre and publishes a procedure for a digital plan and a property location certificate.
registry.serviceEvidence: Official national MIDAGRI/SERFOR ArcGIS REST service exposes the Cajamarca rural-predio layer publicly.

sourceAssessment.nativeIdentity: UNICAT (six-character string); ArcGIS OBJECTID is also exposed as an OID. Use UNICAT as the preferred stable native identity, with OBJECTID only as a service-row identifier.
sourceAssessment.compositeKeyProvenance: No composite key needed for the bounded response; UNICAT is the native parcel identity returned by the layer.

boundedEvidence.result: Returned three full Polygon features intersecting the 0.02-degree envelope around the unchanged WUP point; native identifiers included UNICAT 79790, 78948, and 39108 in the first three returned features.
